compiled_state.title: Add churn-append subcommand to calibration-report.sh with idempotency guard
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying:
- dd-2: calibration-report.sh churn-append posts a single entry to suite-churn-history for a given PR's suite churn metrics
- dd-5: Running churn-append twice for the same PR identifier produces exactly one entry (idempotency guard)

Add the churn-append subcommand to plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh:

  calibration-report.sh churn-append --pr=<pr-number> --metrics-file=<json-path>

The subcommand:
1. Reads suite churn metrics from --metrics-file (JSON)
2. Checks suite-churn-history tracking ticket for an existing entry with the same PR number (idempotency check using HTML comment marker <!-- calibration-rollup: pr=<N> kind=churn -->)
3. If entry exists: exits 0 without posting duplicate
4. If no entry: posts a single comment to suite-churn-history via .claude/scripts/dso ticket comment
5. Shares helper functions with mutation-append (idempotency check logic is the same pattern, parameterized by tracking-ticket-alias + kind)

Create tests/scripts/test-calibration-churn-append.sh covering:
- First invocation posts one entry
- Second invocation with same PR is a no-op
- --dry-run skips posting and exits 0

## Testing Mode
RED — write test first; fails because churn-append subcommand does not exist.

## Acceptance Criteria
- calibration-report.sh churn-append exists — Verify: grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*churn-append\)' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh
- Idempotency test passes — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-calibration-churn-append.sh
- Test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-calibration-churn-append.sh
- Shared helper called from both subcommands (not duplicated) — Verify: grep -c 'idempotency_check\|check_idempotent\|_check_dup' plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 2)}'

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/calibration-report.sh — Edit
- tests/scripts/test-calibration-churn-append.sh — Create

comments.body: Gap analysis AC amendment: Specify error handling — non-zero exit when (a) --metrics-file is missing or malformed JSON, (b) suite-churn-history ticket fetch fails, (c) post call fails. A failed post does NOT count as 'posted' for idempotency (no marker written on failed post). All failures emit to stderr with actionable message.
